claims.text: Small ulcers: moxifloxacin 0.5% or gatifloxacin 0.3–0.5%. Larger or central ulcers: fortified tobramycin 15 mg/mL + cefazolin 50 mg/mL. Dose often at first (eg, q15 min × 4, then hourly around the clock)
claims.quote: Treatment for all ulcers, regardless of cause, begins with moxifloxacin 0.5% or gatifloxacin 0.3 to 0.5% eye drops for small ulcers and fortified (higher than stock concentration) antibiotic drops, such as tobramycin 15 mg/mL and cefazolin 50 mg/mL, for more significant ulcers, particularly those that are near or involve the center of the cornea. Frequent dosing (eg, every 15 minutes for 4 doses, followed by every hour around the clock) is necessary initially.
